title: Why We Call It Spring
short_teaser: The season’s name is connected to plants springing or rising from the ground.
story: The season’s name is connected to plants springing or rising from the ground. A word can preserve the visible movement that defined a season. Words shape what we notice, remember, and make possible together. The value is not only knowing the story, but recognizing where the same pattern may already be present in ordinary life, creative work, or business.
